annotations.title: Get a clinical trial by NCT ID

description: Fetch a single ClinicalTrials.gov study by its NCT id (format NCT######## — the letters 'NCT' followed by digits, e.g. NCT00841061). Returns the full study object { protocolSection, derivedSection?, hasResults? }. Use `fields` to return only specific fields/modules. GET /studies/{nctId}.

fields.description: Fields or modules to return, e.g. ['protocolSection.identificationModule','protocolSection.statusModule']. Omit for the full record.

nctId.description: The study's NCT id, format NCT######## (e.g. NCT00841061).

name: get_study
title: Get a clinical trial by NCT ID
